title: Restriction, exchange and open adjunct normalization in product coordinates
statement: For arbitrary compactifications cf,cg, quasi-compact g, finite commutative A, and every unbounded derived object Q on cf.Z×B cg.Z, sectionwise rho_Q equals the specified proper exchange. The open Hom equivalence sends properOpenMate at P_i Q to lambda_(P_i Q) inverse. Finally P_k R_t(epsilon_i,Q) followed by rho_Q equals lambda_(P_i Q). All coordinates are those of def-pur-product-exchange-coordinate-data; no exchange on a proper map is inverted.

source.place: Symmetry paragraph, reduction to proper maps, expanded by product-coordinate node Steps 3--8; Stacks Tags 09BN, 0E47 and 0F7J.

proof.text: Represent Q by a K-injective complex. Sectionwise open restriction evaluates on the same pullback object as the transpose of the unit-square-counit exchange. The equality holds termwise and survives right-derived localization.

The Cartesian square makes the clopen intermediate lift an isomorphism. Restrict the canonical clopen-projection proper mate, paste its proper adjunctions and use triangle identities; its open adjunct is inverse restriction followed by open unit, hence lambda inverse.

Naturality of rho at epsilon_i gives P_k R_t(epsilon_i) followed by rho_Q equal to rho_(i! P_i Q) followed by R_v P_i(epsilon_i). The open triangle identity identifies P_i(epsilon_i) with inverse eta_i at P_i Q. Transport between exact and total pullback gives exactly the composite used by lambda.

theorem productOpenAdjunctionNormalization
    {B X Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ B} {g : Z ⟶ B}
    (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g) [QuasiCompact g]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (Q : ProperOpenDerived (ULift.{u + 1} A) (pullback cf.g cg.g)) :
    (rho A (pullback.snd cf.g g) (i cf cg) cg.i
      (pullback.snd cf.g cg.g) (square cf cg)).hom.app Q =
        (derivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A))
          (square cf cg).flip.toCommSq).app Q ∧
    (properOpenAdj (ULift.{u + 1} A) cg.i).homEquiv _ _
      ((properOpenMate (ULift.{u + 1} A) (i cf cg) (pullback.snd cf.g g)
        (pullback.snd cf.g cg.g) cg.i (comm cf cg)).app
          ((ProperOpenPull (ULift.{u + 1} A) (i cf cg)).obj Q)) =
      (lambda cf cg A ((ProperOpenPull (ULift.{u + 1} A) (i cf cg)).obj Q)).inv ∧
    (ProperOpenPull (ULift.{u + 1} A) cg.i).map
        ((ProperOpenPush (ULift.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd cf.g cg.g)).map
          ((properOpenAdj (ULift.{u + 1} A) (i cf cg)).counit.app Q)) ≫
      (rho A (pullback.snd cf.g g) (i cf cg) cg.i
        (pullback.snd cf.g cg.g) (square cf cg)).hom.app Q =
      (lambda cf cg A ((ProperOpenPull (ULift.{u + 1} A) (i cf cg)).obj Q)).hom
